data.narrative:
Solar Foods operates in Biotech & Health as a public-stage company. The peer universe comprises 3 same-sector, same-stage public comparables (Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience) alongside 8 private-stage peers, with an additional 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) tracked for sector context.

Peer-Median valuation represents the only applicable triangulation method. The median valuation across the 3 public-stage biotech peers is $1.1B, with a range of $1.0B (Alto Neuroscience) to $1.6B (Recursion Pharmaceuticals). Public-Comp Anchoring using sector P/S multiples (6.6x median across the 3 public tickers) cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue data for Solar Foods. This is standard for private-to-public stage transitions where revenue metrics remain proprietary.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $935M to $1.3B, centered on $1.1B derived from peer median. The band widens given reliance on a single methodological anchor and inherent comparability noise across biotech peers at different maturity levels. Primary uncertainty stems from Solar Foods' unreported revenue and growth trajectory relative to named peers. Stage transition timing and market conditions also materially influence placement within the derived range. Capital raised to date ($160M+) provides floor context but does not directly constrain valuation outcomes.
